calendar.tour1Body: Your schedule is set: each day is colored by parent. School holidays, public holidays, and special days are already there, years in advance. Tap a day to act on it.
calendar.tour2Body: Need a Wednesday? Tap the day and propose a swap. The other parent accepts, declines, or counter-proposes — and the calendar updates on its own.
calendar.tour3Body: Expenses tab: log who paid for what (meals, health, activities). Alternly tracks the balance between you and handles reimbursements. No more back-of-the-envelope math.
calendar.tour4Body: Wall tab: share an update, a to-do to check off (with a due date on the calendar), or a question. One clear thread, on your own time, instead of texts that get lost.
